t.zh: 真值表要一行一行地填。<wiki-ref to="circuit"></wiki-ref>只接一次，由机器在每一行上运行。
t.en: A truth table is filled in row by row. A <wiki-ref to="circuit"></wiki-ref> is wired once, and the machine runs it on every row.

t.zh: 左边的「下雨」输出它在当前行的真值；右边的「这句话」收下电路的输出。
t.en: “It rains” on the left gives its value on the current row; “The sentence” on the right takes the board’s output.

t.zh: 新元件表示否定 ¬：输入为真，输出假；输入为假，输出真。
t.en: The new part stands for negation, ¬: true in gives false out, false in gives true out.

t.zh: 点真值表的一行，板上会显示各元件在这一行的值。
t.en: Select a row of the truth table to see each part’s value on that row.

brief.zh: 接一块电路，算出「不是『不下雨』」在每一行的真值。
brief.en: Wire a board that works out the value of “it is not the case that it is not raining” on every row.

hint.zh: 「不下雨」怎样接？再否定一次呢？
hint.en: How is “it is not raining” wired? And negated once more?
